newsitem.title: USA: Multimedia MegaMania game object of probe.
newsitem.headline: Multimedia MegaMania game object of probe.

text.p: MultiMedia Games Inc said Friday the federal prosecutor here is investigating whether the company's MegaMania game is Class II or Class III as defined by the Indian Gaming Regulatory Act of 1988.
Class III games cannot be played in a state unless a gaming tribe has negotiated a compact with the state.
Class II games require no such compact.
Multimedia Games said it has relied on a finding by the National Indian Gaming Commission that the company's MegaMania game is a Class II game. It said the commission's finding should be conclusive.
MegaMania represents about 25 percent of the company's gross revenues for its fiscal year ended September 30.
